catalog.description: Open the builder from the pages list, WordPress editor or admin bar.

catalog.title: Accordion

catalog.title: Add To Cart

catalog.title: Alert
catalog.description: A colored notice (info, success, warning, danger) with a title, description and optional dismiss button.

catalog.title: Animated Headline
catalog.description: A headline with a hand-drawn highlight (circle, underline, strike ...) or rotating words (typing, flip, clip ...). Screen readers get the full sentence.

catalog.title: Archive posts
catalog.description: The posts of the current archive, blog or search query as cards, with pagination. Outside an archive it lists the latest posts.

catalog.title: Archive title
catalog.description: The title of the current archive (category, tag, author, date, post type), the blog or the search results.

catalog.title: Author box
catalog.description: The author of the current post: avatar, name, biography and a link to their posts.

catalog.title: Link in Bio
catalog.description: A stack (or grid) of large link buttons with an icon and sub-label, for link-in-bio pages.

catalog.title: Blockquote
catalog.description: A styled quotation with author, source link and a Tweet button that shares the quote.

catalog.title: Breadcrumbs
catalog.description: Home › parents › current page. Uses the Yoast SEO or Rank Math breadcrumbs when one of them is active.

catalog.title: Button
catalog.description: A call-to-action button with icon, size presets and hover styles.

catalog.title: Call to Action
catalog.description: A promo box with an image (classic: above or beside the content, cover: behind it), ribbon, icon, title, text and button, hover effects, optionally clickable as a whole.

catalog.title: Cart
catalog.description: WooCommerce's cart ([woocommerce_cart]): items table, coupon, cross-sells and totals, with styling for tables, inputs, buttons and notices.

catalog.title: Checkout
catalog.description: WooCommerce's checkout ([woocommerce_checkout]): billing / shipping fields, order review and payment, with styling controls.

catalog.title: Code Highlight
catalog.description: A syntax-highlighted code snippet with line numbers, highlighted lines, a copy button and light or dark themes.

catalog.title: Comments
catalog.description: The comments and the comment form of the current post (the theme's comments template when it has one).

catalog.title: Container
catalog.description: Flexible box that holds other elements. Direction, alignment and gap are responsive.

catalog.title: Countdown
catalog.description: A countdown to a date (site timezone) or an evergreen timer per visitor, with days / hours / minutes / seconds, labels, separators and actions when it ends: hide, show a message, redirect or open a popup.

catalog.title: Counter
catalog.description: An animated number that counts from start to end when it scrolls into view, with prefix, suffix, separator and title.

catalog.title: Divider
catalog.description: A horizontal line with style, weight, width and alignment, optionally with text or an icon in the middle.

catalog.title: Facebook
catalog.description: Facebook page plugin, comments, embedded post or video, like and share buttons. The Facebook SDK loads only when the widget becomes visible or after a click, with an optional privacy notice.

catalog.title: Featured image
catalog.description: The featured image of the current post, with an optional caption and link.

catalog.title: Flip Box
catalog.description: A card with a front and a back side that flips, slides, pushes, zooms or fades on hover, tap or keyboard focus. Use the Show back side button on the canvas to edit the back.

catalog.title: Form
catalog.description: Form builder: any number of fields (text, email, select, radio, checkbox, upload ...), multi-step wizard, validation in the browser and on the server, actions after submit (email, redirect, popup, stored submissions).

catalog.title: Contact Form
catalog.description: A lightweight name / email / message form. Submissions are sent by email through the REST API with honeypot and rate limiting.

catalog.title: Gallery
catalog.description: A responsive grid of images with captions, hover effects and lightbox links. Images are lazy loaded.

catalog.title: Gallery Pro
catalog.description: Several galleries in one widget with a filter bar: grid, justified or masonry layouts, captions, hover animations, lightbox and per-image links. Images are lazy loaded.

catalog.title: Google Maps
catalog.description: Embeds a Google Map for an address (no API key needed). Responsive height, map type and scroll protection.

catalog.title: Grid
catalog.description: CSS grid container. Columns, rows, gaps and auto-flow are responsive; children get column/row span controls in their Advanced tab.

catalog.title: Heading
catalog.description: A heading with an HTML tag, alignment, color and typography. Double-click to edit inline.

catalog.title: Hotspot
catalog.description: An image with clickable points that show tooltips. Drag the points on the canvas to place them.

catalog.title: HTML
catalog.description: Custom HTML markup, limited to the tags allowed in post content. Scripts, styles and event handlers are removed.

catalog.title: Icon
catalog.description: A Font Awesome icon (or custom SVG) with size, colors, shape and rotation.

catalog.title: Icon Box
catalog.description: An icon with a title and description, stacked or side by side. Optional link.

catalog.title: Icon list
catalog.description: A list of items with an icon, text and optional link. Vertical or inline layout with optional dividers.

catalog.title: Image
catalog.description: An image from the media library with size, alignment, link or lightbox, caption and hover effects.

catalog.title: Image Box
catalog.description: An image with a title and description, side by side or stacked. Optional link.

catalog.title: Image Carousel
catalog.description: A responsive image slider with arrows, dots, autoplay, loop and swipe. Powered by a tiny dependency-free runtime.

catalog.title: Login
catalog.description: The WordPress login form (posts to wp-login.php) with remember me, lost password link and redirects. Logged-in visitors see a message with a log out link.

catalog.title: Loop Carousel
catalog.description: A slider of posts of any post type, each rendered with a loop item template from the Theme Builder.

catalog.title: Taxonomy Filter
catalog.description: Filters a Loop Grid or Loop Carousel on the page by the terms of a taxonomy, without reloading the page.

catalog.title: Loop Grid
catalog.description: Lists posts of any post type with a loop item template from the Theme Builder: query, responsive columns, masonry, pagination, load more and infinite scroll.

catalog.title: Lottie
catalog.description: Lightweight Lottie (JSON) animation drawn on a canvas, played on load, hover, click, when visible or linked to scrolling.

catalog.title: Media Carousel
catalog.description: Images and videos in a carousel, a slideshow with thumbnails or a coverflow, with a lightbox that plays videos.

catalog.title: Mega menu
catalog.description: A navigation whose items open a dropdown panel holding any elements (full width or boxed), on hover or click; an accordion on mobile.

catalog.title: Menu Anchor
catalog.description: An invisible anchor target for in-page links (#id) with smooth scrolling.

catalog.title: Menu Cart
catalog.description: Cart icon with item count and subtotal for headers; opens WooCommerce's mini cart in an off-canvas panel or a dropdown. Updates live through WooCommerce's cart fragments.

catalog.title: My Account
catalog.description: WooCommerce's account page ([woocommerce_my_account]): login / register, dashboard, orders, addresses and account details.

catalog.title: Nav menu
catalog.description: A WordPress menu (Appearance → Menus): horizontal, vertical or dropdown, with submenus and a hamburger toggle below a breakpoint.

catalog.title: Off-Canvas
catalog.description: A panel that slides in from a side of the screen. Open it with its button or any link to #zx-off-canvas:<element id>. Inside a loop item each item opens its own panel.

catalog.title: PayPal button
catalog.description: Buy now, Donate or Subscribe with PayPal Standard (a form posted to PayPal; no API keys).

catalog.title: Portfolio
catalog.description: A filterable grid of posts of any post type: image tiles with the title on hover and a filter bar of taxonomy terms that filters instantly, without reloading.

catalog.title: Post content
catalog.description: The content of the current post (the_content: blocks, shortcodes and Zadex layouts). Use it in single templates.

catalog.title: Post excerpt
catalog.description: The excerpt of the current post (the manual excerpt, or the first words of the content).

catalog.title: Post info
catalog.description: Meta data of the current post: date, time, author, comments, terms or a custom text, each with an icon.

catalog.title: Post navigation
catalog.description: Links to the previous and next post, with labels, titles and arrows.

catalog.title: Post title
catalog.description: The title of the current post (single templates) with an HTML tag and an optional link to the post.

catalog.title: Posts
catalog.description: Lists posts of any post type as classic, card or full content items: query, responsive columns, masonry, meta, excerpt, pagination, load more and infinite scroll.

catalog.title: Price List
catalog.description: A menu-style list of items with title, price, description, image and link, joined by a dotted, dashed or solid separator.

catalog.title: Price Table
catalog.description: A pricing plan card: header, price with currency and period, original price, feature list with icons and tooltips, button, footer text, ribbon and a featured highlight.

catalog.title: Product Categories
catalog.description: A grid of product categories with image, name and product count (the current product's categories, top level or chosen ones).

catalog.title: Product Data Tabs
catalog.description: WooCommerce's product tabs: description, additional information and reviews (plus tabs added by plugins).

catalog.title: Product Images
catalog.description: The product gallery with WooCommerce's own zoom, lightbox and thumbnail slider scripts.

catalog.title: Product Meta
catalog.description: SKU, categories and tags of the current product.

catalog.title: Product Price
catalog.description: The product price (sale price with the regular one struck through; variable products show the range).

catalog.title: Product Rating
catalog.description: The product's average rating (stars) and the reviews link.

catalog.title: Related Products
catalog.description: Products related to the current one (same categories / tags), as product cards.

catalog.title: Short Description
catalog.description: The product's short description.

catalog.title: Product Stock
catalog.description: Stock status of the current product ("In stock", "3 in stock", "Out of stock", backorders).

catalog.title: Product Title
catalog.description: The current product's name (single product templates; the editor previews the template's preview product).

catalog.title: Upsells
catalog.description: The current product's up-sells, as product cards.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.description: A grid of products: latest, on sale, featured, by category / tag, chosen ids, best selling, top rated or the current archive query; columns, rows, pagination and card styling.

catalog.title: Progress bar
catalog.description: A labelled bar that fills to a percentage when it scrolls into view. Accessible role=progressbar.

catalog.title: Purchase Summary
catalog.description: Order details for the thank-you page (the checkout "order received" endpoint): overview, items, totals and addresses. The editor previews the latest order.

catalog.title: Read More
catalog.description: Marks the excerpt boundary (like <!--more-->). On archive pages the content is cut here and a "Read more" link is appended.

catalog.title: Reading Progress
catalog.description: A bar fixed to the top or bottom of the screen that fills while the visitor reads the page or a chosen content area.

catalog.title: Reviews
catalog.description: Customer reviews in a slider: name, title, image, star rating, text and a source icon (Google, Facebook, X, Trustpilot or your own).

catalog.title: Instant Search
catalog.description: A search box that shows matching posts and pages while typing (keyboard navigation, thumbnails, "View all results"). Without JavaScript it is a normal WordPress search form.

catalog.title: Search form
catalog.description: A WordPress search form: input with a text or icon button, or an icon that opens a full-screen search.

catalog.title: Share Buttons
catalog.description: Buttons that share the current page on social networks, by email, print it or copy its link. Optional native share sheet on mobile.

catalog.title: Shortcode
catalog.description: Renders any WordPress shortcode. The preview is rendered by the server.

catalog.title: Sidebar
catalog.description: Renders a registered WordPress widget area (sidebar). The preview is rendered by the server.

catalog.title: Site logo
catalog.description: The site logo (the Customizer logo or a chosen image) linking to the home page.

catalog.title: Site title
catalog.description: The site title (Settings → General), optionally with the tagline, linking to the home page.

catalog.title: Sitemap
catalog.description: Lists of the site's pages, posts, categories and tags, with a depth for hierarchical lists.

catalog.title: Slides
catalog.description: A full-width hero slider: per-slide background, Ken Burns, overlay, heading, text and button, with slide or fade transitions, autoplay and accessible controls.

catalog.title: Social Icons
catalog.description: A row of social network links with official brand colours (Font Awesome brand icons), shapes and hover animations.

catalog.title: SoundCloud
catalog.description: Embeds a SoundCloud track or playlist with the visual player and its options.

catalog.title: Spacer
catalog.description: Empty vertical space with a responsive height.

catalog.title: Star Rating
catalog.description: A star rating on a 5 or 10 scale with partial stars, marked/unmarked colors and an optional title.

catalog.title: Stripe button
catalog.description: Take payments with a Stripe Payment Link, or a Checkout Session created on the server.

catalog.title: SVG
catalog.description: Inline SVG markup with size, fill color and an optional link. Scripts and event handlers are removed.

catalog.title: Table of Contents
catalog.description: Lists the headings of the page with links to them: nested or flat, numbered, collapsible, sticky, with smooth scrolling and the current heading highlighted.

catalog.title: Tabs
catalog.description: Tabbed content. Each tab is a droppable container; horizontal or vertical navigation with keyboard support.

catalog.title: Template
catalog.description: Inserts a saved template (My templates) or a theme template. Edit the template once and every page using it updates.

catalog.title: Testimonial
catalog.description: A customer quote with image, name and role. Image above, inside the meta row or aside the content.

catalog.title: Testimonial Carousel
catalog.description: Customer quotes in a slider: content, image, name and title with default or speech-bubble skins and five image layouts.

catalog.title: Text
catalog.description: Rich text with bold, italic, links, lists and headings. Double-click to edit inline.

catalog.title: Text Path
catalog.description: Text that follows a curve: wave, arc, circle, line or your own SVG path.

catalog.title: Toggle
catalog.description: Collapsible list where every item can be open at once; all items start closed. Same items and styling as the Accordion.

catalog.title: Video
catalog.description: YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted video with autoplay, mute, loop, poster image and aspect ratio.

catalog.title: Video Playlist
catalog.description: A video player with a clickable list of YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted videos, thumbnails, durations and autoplay of the next video.
